newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easier ahead of the weekend.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easier ahead of the weekend.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.2900/2980 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday, ahead of the Friday weekend and against the previous close at 43.2800/2900, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted easier at 43.2870/2970 per dollar in early trade, but slipped further on dollar demand from two major nationalised banks.
Most deals were, however, done at 43.2970 per dollar.
The call money was traded at 7.25 to 7.75 percent, marginally down from the previous 7.5-8.0 percent, dealers said.
Banks in Bangladesh close transactions by Thursday midday.
